prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: component render for a terminal/TUI coding agent cockpit
Primary request: Create a polished dark terminal UI component for the TomorrowEdge header and safe-mode status strip. Exact text: "TomorrowEdge / tedge", "visible multi-model coding workflow", "SAFE MODE · approval required".
Style/medium: high-fidelity terminal UI mockup, programmer aesthetic, monospaced typography, sharp thin borders, restrained color.
Composition/framing: one wide horizontal header component, no browser chrome, no surrounding app frame.
Color palette: graphite black #0b0f14, panel #111827, border #273142, text #d6deeb, muted #7d8590, cyan #58a6ff, amber #d29922.
Constraints: simple, quiet, premium terminal tool, no logo, no mascot, no neon, no gradients, no glossy 3D, no marketing style.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: component render for TomorrowEdge TUI cockpit
Primary request: Create a polished terminal UI component showing an Agents pane next to a compact Router pane. Include rows for Planner, Explorer, Coder-A, Reviewer, Judge, Runner. Include provider/model chips like mock/balanced, fixture/scripted, local/shell. Show statuses success, running, waiting.
Style/medium: high-fidelity terminal UI mockup, clean programmer aesthetic, monospaced typography, sharp borders, dense but readable.
Composition/framing: two adjacent panes, Agents pane larger on left, Router pane narrower on right, no full app frame.
Color palette: dark graphite background, muted gray panes, cyan active, green success, amber waiting, red failure only if needed.
Constraints: sober, minimal, highly legible, no decorative illustration, no fake macOS/browser chrome, no rounded SaaS cards.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: component render for TomorrowEdge diff approval pane
Primary request: Create a polished terminal UI component showing a unified diff and an approval prompt. Exact visible snippets: "Diff", "fixture_candidate_a", "-  return a - b;", "+  return a + b;", "Awaiting patch approval", "press a to apply".
Style/medium: high-fidelity terminal UI mockup, programmer aesthetic, monospaced typography, thin borders.
Composition/framing: one large code diff pane with a compact approval footer, no full app frame.
Color palette: graphite black, muted panel gray, green additions, red deletions, amber approval warning, subtle cyan selection line.
Constraints: no marketing style, no neon cyberpunk, no heavy glow, no mascot, no big rounded cards.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: component render for TomorrowEdge debate and evidence panes
Primary request: Create a polished terminal UI component with two stacked panes: Debate and Evidence. Debate should compare Coder-A and Coder-B, reviewer score, judge selects fixture_candidate_a. Evidence should show npm test pending/pass state and session evidence.
Style/medium: high-fidelity terminal UI mockup, sober programmer cockpit, monospaced, thin borders, dense but readable.
Composition/framing: stacked panes with clear hierarchy, no browser chrome.
Color palette: dark graphite, muted gray, cyan selected judge line, green pass, amber pending, red reserved for errors.
Constraints: no gradients, no decorative graphics, no logo, no stock imagery, no glossy 3D.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: component render for TomorrowEdge shell, memory, and help panes
Primary request: Create a polished terminal UI component showing Shell command proposal, Memory session facts, and Help keybindings. Include exact text: "proposed: npm test", "session memory", "a apply", "t test", "q quit".
Style/medium: high-fidelity terminal UI mockup, minimal programmer aesthetic, monospaced typography, thin borders.
Composition/framing: three compact panes in a grid, no full app frame.
Color palette: graphite black, gray panels, cyan keybindings, amber proposed command, green success accents.
Constraints: no marketing hero, no neon, no mascot, no icons, no rounded SaaS cards.
